newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.9 Jan 3 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.9 Jan 3 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) held steady at 105.9 in the week ended January 3, unchanged from 105.9 the prior week, ECRI said.

The growth rates of both real estate loans and industrial materials prices increased, while the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries widened, leading to no changed in the FIG, ECRI said.
"The movements of the FIG continue to suggest inflation will remain in the current range over the next few months," it said.
